The same principle: understand the complexity deeply enough to make the experience feel simple. {.bloco} {imagem} nome: germanico.png tamanho: M tags: Art Direction, Design, Project Management {} chapeu: Estadão h4: Redesigning a System at Scale A high-frequency information product, a multidisciplinary organization, and a visual system balancing editorial expression, production constraints, and business goals. I led the redesign strategy across editorial, product, production, and commercial requirements. The new system supported operational optimization and a new advertising strategy, contributing to an estimated R$7 million increase in EBITDA (2022). I designed the experience, defined the product logic, and built software connecting interfaces to real business data. Read the full product design case study → {divisor} {bloco} {imagem} nome: newsletters/saiba-agora.jpg tamanho: P classes: shadow-2 tags: Product Strategy, UX/UI, Data Analysis {} chapeu: Personalized newsletters h4: Testing Relevance at Scale Could personalization make a daily news briefing more relevant? We tested two recommendation systems across ten audience clusters against an editorial control group. Overall click-through was similar. The real signal was in understanding which audiences responded to personalization — and what a longer experiment would need to prove. Read the personalization case study → {} {divisor} {imagem} nome: blue/tela02.png tamanho: M classes: tags: Product Design, UX/UI, Interaction Design {} chapeu: Blue h4: Designing for a New Interaction Model In 2010, tablets introduced a new question: what happens to information when touch replaces the mouse? Blue explored financial news as a continuous, gesture-driven stream — not a website squeezed onto a smaller screen. An R&D prototype for learning how touch changed navigation, hierarchy, density, and reading behavior. Read the interaction design case → {.bloco} {video} nome: fabia.mov tamanho: G tags: Full-Stack, Code, API, UX/UI, Project Management, Business Strategy {} chapeu: fab.IA h4: Talking to Business Data Could natural language become an interface to enterprise data? I built an early prototype connecting speech recognition, language processing, SQL queries, and data visualization. Built with Svelte, Node.js, and D3.js. An exploratory experiment rather than a production product. {} {divisor} h3: Three decades of craft. Still hands-on. I lead at the system level and stay close enough to the work to prototype, design, build, refine, and ship. Complexity is the material. Simplicity is the outcome. h5: Let's talk. fabio.sales@me.com →
